blocking_defect.root_cause: prepare_canonical_turn calls datetime.now(timezone.utc) for every CurrentConversationalTaskContext provenance observation. observed_at is included in the current-task digest, gate receipt, semantic fingerprint, and P4-C1 replay digest. Repeated preparation of the same exact request can therefore cross a one-second boundary and produce different semantic/replay evidence even though provenance_payload and all semantic inputs are identical.
